title: Mini-Retirements: Embracing the Mobile Lifestyle
coreMove: A mini-retirement works when remote income, lower-cost geography, and local routines turn travel into lived practice instead of delayed escape.

exampleSpecs.audience: a remote analyst arranging a first month abroad
exampleSpecs.stakes: The stay could become shallow tourism unless the days acquire rhythm.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use Argentina and Buenos Aires to show mini-retirement as lived routine.

exampleSpecs.audience: a couple deciding whether to add more countries
exampleSpecs.stakes: A rushed route could raise daily cost and turn time abundance into pressure.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show RTW planning favoring long-stay travel and daily cost over checklist travel.

exampleSpecs.audience: a designer using travel to rebuild energy
exampleSpecs.stakes: Unstructured freedom may drift into boredom and anxious scrolling.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use Spanish and tango as structure for free time.

exampleSpecs.audience: a parent testing whether a month away is financially possible
exampleSpecs.stakes: The family may reject the stay by assuming travel stacks on top of home costs.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use long-stay travel and daily cost to make geographic arbitrage concrete.

exampleSpecs.audience: a consultant proving whether work survives absence
exampleSpecs.stakes: A planned trip will expose whether income is truly mobile or still dependent on one desk.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show a mini-retirement testing remote systems through distance.

exampleSpecs.audience: a household deciding how to adapt mini-retirement
exampleSpecs.stakes: School, work, and care routines could make the idea seem limited to single travelers.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show families adapting Argentina immersion through calendars and routine.
